solution = [1, 3, 0, 2]

print("Verification for solution:", solution)
print()
print("Board (Q = queen, . = empty):")
print("     Col0 Col1 Col2 Col3")
for row, col in enumerate(solution):
    line = [".", ".", ".", "."]
    line[col] = "Q"
    print(f"Row{row}  " + "    ".join(line))

print()
print("Checking constraints:")
n = len(solution)
ok = True
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        same_col  = solution[i] == solution[j]
        same_diag = abs(i - j) == abs(solution[i] - solution[j])
        if same_col or same_diag:
            print(f"  CONFLICT between row {i} and row {j}!")
            ok = False
if ok:
    print("  ✓ No two queens share a row (by construction)")
    print("  ✓ No two queens share a column")
    print("  ✓ No two queens share a diagonal")
    print("  → All constraints satisfied!")
